name: Pineapple (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Pineapple (Ananas comosus) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169124 (Pineapple, raw, all varieties)

Ma, Yang, Wu et al. 2018, 'Physico-Chemical Properties, Antioxidant Activity and Mineral Contents of Pineapple Genotypes Grown in China', Molecules 23(11):2914, PMC6270947 (organic acids, sugars, minerals by HPLC)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for a microbe on pineapple are sucrose (~175 mM) plus free fructose and glucose, then the organic-acid pool dominated by citric acid (~18 mM) with malic and quinic acids. Citric and quinic acids were the key growth-relevant omissions in the prior FooDB profile. Manganese is unusually high for a fruit.
curation_added: citric acid (0.346 g/100g) - dominant organic acid, was entirely absent
quinic acid (0.090 g/100g) - third major organic acid, was absent
specific sugars with real amounts: sucrose 5.99, fructose 2.12, glucose 1.73 g/100g
full quantitative amino acid, vitamin and mineral panel with amounts

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed vitamin A is animal-derived; pineapple (plant food) contains 0 retinol - vitamin A activity is entirely from beta-carotene. FooDB/BiGG artifact.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt ion is not a measured growth nutrient of pineapple at meaningful levels; FooDB ultratrace/contaminant noise.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Non-nutritive ultratrace element, not a documented pineapple nutrient; FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Starch C12H20O10
curation_removed.reason: Ripe pineapple starch is essentially 0 (USDA); retained as a 0-value entry only, not a real carbon pool in edible fruit.

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Redundant compartment-tagged duplicate of iron (BiGG ID artifact); iron kept once.

curation_removed.name: Iron (Fe3+)
curation_removed.reason: Redundant duplicate iron entry (BiGG oxidation-state artifact); iron kept once.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
